mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.subject_code, s.subject_name, s.grade_id, g.grade_name, g.sort_no AS gradeSortNo FROM t_as_subject s INNER JOIN t_educl_grade g ON s.grade_id = g.id AND g.is_valid = 1 WHERE s.is_valid = 1 AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY g.sort_no ASC, g.id ASC, s.subject_code ASC
